descriptionChirho: Abstract feminine noun meaning knowledge, understanding, or awareness, used of both human and divine knowledge in wisdom and prophetic literature (Job 32:6,10,17; 36:3; Ps 73:11; Isa 28:9). All three clusters represent the same lexical meaning in different grammatical forms (singular absolute, singular construct, plural): spa 'conocimiento/conocimientos,' arb 'مَعْرِفَةً/المَعارِفِ/عِلْمٍ' (knowledge/knowledges/learning), kor '지식을/지식들이/지식들의' (knowledge sg and pl), swa 'maarifa/ujuzi' (knowledge/expertise), hin 'ज्ञान/ज्ञानों' (knowledge sg/pl). The plural forms are intensive or distributive, not semantically distinct.
